metadata.title: POM-informed Product Deployment
metadata.description: Current lean schema: product composition is carried by deployed bricks and usedInProducts. Proposed runtime partitions include shared dependencies, not verified POM infrastructure. The pilot gate and recovery sequence are modeled in the live and safe streams.

channels.description: Managed web and API delivery with approved provider integration. No native app or customer-funds custody is assumed.
Proposed logical deployment partition, not a verified POM cloud account. Provider, availability, EU residency and runtime boundaries require discovery.
